results.detail: The condition texts are exact (DTSX:42647-42653; main.cs:57-60). However, meaning_he of [1], 'ואין פיצול מתאים', describes NOT-EXISTS semantics, and the SQL does not implement them. The SQL is a row-level LEFT JOIN to CP2 = all partitions of the request. (a) If the request already has partitions, but only on other funds, no row survives and no partition is created, although this fund has no matching partition. (b) If the request has, on this fund, one partition with the same product and another with a different product, the row with the different product passes, and a partition is created although a matching one exists. NULL CP2.gen_fundnumberdest/gen_product also drops the row.

wrongUnits.problem: Misstates the semantics of the condition (NOT EXISTS vs. row-level LEFT JOIN).

Set delevery delay main.cs:117-124 first sets gen_deliverydelay = false. It becomes true only when both dates exist and (actual - delivery).Days > 0. So false is computed when the transfer is less than a full day late, or when either date is missing. Update transferin then writes it whenever the stored value is NULL or different (main.cs:57-60). A request previously marked late is therefore reset to false. This written value is missing.
